resources.string: Prepare your optional TMDB connection for movie and show details. Your local library and playback work without it.
Each search is started by you from a title. Player sends only its normalized title, year and media type. Results are saved only after you confirm a match.
When enabled, Player may send normalized titles, year and media type directly to api.themoviedb.org and fetch artwork from image.tmdb.org.
Your videos, subtitles, folder names, file paths and original filenames stay on your device. Disabling metadata keeps your local library available.
Use your own TMDB API Read Access Token. Player encrypts it on this device and excludes it from app backup.
Paste a token from your TMDB account
Leave this field empty to keep the saved token. Player never displays it again.
Saved token and metadata consent removed.
Player could not open or save this connection. Metadata is disabled. Remove the saved connection, then enter your token again.
Enter a valid API Read Access Token without spaces or line breaks.
This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
Search is manual. Only the normalized title, year and movie or series type are sent. Player never searches automatically or sends your filename, folder or video.
Connect your own TMDB token and enable metadata in Manage before searching.
This filename does not provide a safe movie or series title to search.
No matching titles were found. You can refine the filename locally and rescan.
TMDB rejected the saved token. Check the token in connection settings.
TMDB is limiting requests. Wait a while before trying again.
TMDB could not be reached. Your local library is still available.
TMDB returned data Player could not safely read.
This library changed. Close the details and open the title again before matching.
Player could not read or save the local metadata cache.
